learner.sql: select count(distinct user_id)::int as v from activity_events where {{LEARNERS}} and created_at >= :from and created_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from reading_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and status = 'completed' and submitted_at >= :from and submitted_at < :to

select case when sum(total_questions) > 0 then sum(score)::float8 / sum(total_questions) end as v from reading_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and status = 'completed' and total_questions > 0 and submitted_at >= :from and submitted_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from listening_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and status = 'completed' and submitted_at >= :from and submitted_at < :to

select case when sum(total_questions) > 0 then sum(score)::float8 / sum(total_questions) end as v from listening_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and status = 'completed' and total_questions > 0 and submitted_at >= :from and submitted_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from writing_submissions where {{LEARNERS}} and status in ('submitted', 'evaluated') and submitted_at >= :from and submitted_at < :to

select round(avg(overall_estimate)::numeric, 2)::float8 as v from evaluations where {{LEARNERS}} and source_type in ('writing_submission', 'writing_grade') and overall_estimate is not null and created_at >= :from and created_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from speaking_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and status in ('submitted', 'reviewed') and submitted_at >= :from and submitted_at < :to

select round(avg(overall_estimate)::numeric, 2)::float8 as v from evaluations where {{LEARNERS}} and source_type = 'speaking_attempt' and overall_estimate is not null and created_at >= :from and created_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from retention_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and status = 'completed' and completed_at >= :from and completed_at < :to
select round(avg(score)::numeric, 2)::float8 as v from retention_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and status = 'completed' and score is not null and completed_at >= :from and completed_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from grammar_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and attempted_at >= :from and attempted_at < :to

select case when count(*) filter (where is_correct is not null) > 0 then (count(*) filter (where is_correct))::float8 / count(*) filter (where is_correct is not null) end as v from grammar_attempts where {{LEARNERS}} and attempted_at >= :from and attempted_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from video_lesson_progress where {{LEARNERS}} and completed_at >= :from and completed_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from user_vocabulary where {{LEARNERS}} and created_at >= :from and created_at < :to

cohort.sql: select count(*)::int as v from users where role = 'student' and account_status = 'active' and created_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from users where role = 'student' and created_at >= :from and created_at < :to

roster.sql: select count(*)::int as v from teacher_student_links l join users u on u.id = l.student_user_id where l.teacher_user_id = :teacher and u.role = 'student' and u.account_status = 'active' and l.created_at < :to

owner.sql: select count(*)::int as v from users where role in ('teacher', 'admin', 'owner') and account_status = 'active' and created_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from users where account_status = 'pending' and created_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from problem_reports where created_at >= :from and created_at < :to

owner.sql: select count(*)::int as v from evaluations where provider_type = 'external' and created_at >= :from and created_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from evaluations where provider_type = 'internal' and created_at >= :from and created_at < :to
select count(*)::int as v from evaluations where fallback_used = true and created_at >= :from and created_at < :to
